d: Long, straight ash-brown hair with blunt-cut bangs is tied into a high ponytail secured by red and white ribbons. The eyes are a warm hazel shade with a neutral, focused expression on a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender and petite. The outfit consists of a white wide-sleeved kimono with red lining, a dark grey chest protector, and voluminous red hakama trousers. A white headband with two red stripes is tied across the forehead.
